description: Lightweight rich text editor with a simplified toolbar offering basic formatting (bold, italic, underline), lists (ordered, unordered, task), links, emojis, @mentions, and {{token}} variable insertion. Supports Ctrl+Enter submit, character limit, and focus styling. Token chips support visual differentiation via Icon, ColorClass, and TypeLabel. Hover over a token chip fires OnTokenHover so the application can display its own tooltip. Ideal for comments and inline editing.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: HTML content of the editor. Use @bind-Value for two-way binding.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fired whenever the editor content changes.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text shown when the editor is empty.

parameters.name: MaxLength
parameters.description: Maximum number of characters. When exceeded, the character counter turns red. 0 means unlimited.

parameters.name: SupportsTokens
parameters.description: Enables the {{token}} variable insertion button. Requires TokenProvider.

parameters.name: TokenProvider
parameters.description: Data provider for token/variable search and autocomplete. Setting this implicitly enables token support.

parameters.name: TokenTrigger
parameters.description: Character sequence that opens the token autocomplete dropdown while typing.

parameters.name: OnTokenCreateRequested
parameters.description: Fired when the user clicks 'Create new' in the token dropdown. Parameter is the current query text. Call InsertTokenAsync after the token is created.

parameters.name: OnTokenInserted
parameters.description: Fired after a token chip is inserted into the editor content.

parameters.name: OnTokenHover
parameters.description: Fired when the user hovers over a token chip in the editor. TokenHoverArgs contains full token metadata (Key, DisplayName, Description, Icon, TypeLabel, ColorClass) plus the chip's bounding rect in client (viewport) coordinates (RectLeft, RectTop, RectRight, RectBottom, RectWidth, RectHeight). Use this to show your own tooltip positioned relative to the chip. Only fires when TokenProvider is set and this callback is registered.

parameters.name: OnTokenHoverEnd
parameters.description: Fired when the user moves the cursor away from a token chip. Use this to hide the tooltip shown via OnTokenHover.

parameters.name: IsDisabled
parameters.description: When true, the editor is read-only and visually dimmed.

parameters.name: OnSubmit
parameters.description: Fired when the user presses Ctrl+Enter (or Cmd+Enter on Mac) inside the editor.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the root element.

publicMethods.name: RefreshTokensAsync
publicMethods.description: Refreshes the token list from the provider. Calls Refresh() on the TokenProvider to invalidate its cache, then reloads tokens. Call this after creating or updating tokens so the autocomplete dropdown reflects the changes.

publicMethods.name: InsertTokenAsync

parameters.name: displayName
parameters.description: Text shown in the chip. Falls back to key if null.

publicMethods.description: Programmatically inserts a token chip into the editor at the current cursor position. Typically called after the user creates a new token via OnTokenCreateRequested.

usedAbstractions.name: IToken
usedAbstractions.description: Interface representing a token/variable. Implement it to carry Icon, ColorClass, and TypeLabel for visual chip differentiation.

usedAbstractions.name: TokenHoverArgs
usedAbstractions.description: Event args passed to OnTokenHover. Contains token metadata and the chip's client bounding rect for tooltip positioning.
